title: Recover a valid filtration despite future-dependent fault labels
statement: For each retained classical value, forcing EVERY fault-touched bit to the wrong value yields one pathwise worst trajectory. This envelope is Markov, so drift and exponential exit bounds use a legitimate filtration. Treating the original future-dependent labels themselves as a causal Markov process would be invalid.
